upstream.notes: Real mermaid 11.16.0 stateDiagram-v2 geometry captured via headless Chrome with the bundled Noto fonts. Every state, note and pseudo-state with its centre, its box (in its own coordinates), each text box the SVG gives its labels (a titled state's title, then the description rows, with the height the rows take) and its divider, every composite with each rectangle it draws and its title, every transition with the waypoints the layout gave it (which the path carries), the path's data, its marker and its label, and the canvas (the content's bounding box, as the SVG's getBBox() reports it), all but the node-local parts normalized to the centre of the first node the document shows. Compare, through the render cache, against state::StateScene.

oracle: stateDiagram.render states, notes, transitions, composites and canvas (first-state normalized)
